Bill Gates wants to tax artificial intelligence when it replaces human workers, arguing that robots should contribute to the same social systems funded by ordinary employees. But Russell has had enough of billionaires offering solutions to problems created by the systems they helped build. He asks whether AI could instead be used to dismantle centralized control, empower local communities, and give ordinary people greater independence from governments and corporations.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reacts to Peter Thiel's provocative argument about good and evil, questioning whether competence can ever make evil admirable. From the Antichrist and the banality of evil to the illusion of choice, Russell explores how easily we can become distracted by appearances and lose sight of what it really means to be good.
